description:
As a customer, I want to complete my order.

* The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

criteria.text: The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

cases.title: Finish checkout and see a confirmation
cases.preconditions: A customer account is available and the tester is able to reach the checkout flow with an order ready to be completed.
steps: Open the checkout flow for the prepared order.
Complete the checkout steps through to the final step.
cases.expected: Checkout completes successfully and a confirmation is displayed to the user. The exact content, wording and layout of the confirmation are not specified in the story.
